title: Is it sharing at once, or credit flowing back, that makes OSO get further?

design.question: Is it sharing at once, or credit flowing back, that makes OSO get further?
design.compare: Traditional, OSO (immediate), Flow-back, finished-only, No flow-back, immediate

answer: Best: OSO, 7.9 (1 more tie). Best traditional: Traditional, 5.7. Clear difference.
caveats: A simulation with guessed parameters: it shows how the rules play out, not that they work.
superseded: Earlier version (before 2026-10-24): run on the old random-layer graph, where every parent is required and each level has a fixed chance. Replaced by runs on the idea graph generator.
